description.value:
The liquid is the colour of a sunrise seen through closed eyes, and it is warm in the bottle.

You can drink this potion as a reaction when damage would reduce you to 0 hit points. Instead, you remain standing with hit points equal to half your hit point maximum (any temporary hit points you had count toward this), and the damage is otherwise ignored.

For the next minute, damage can't reduce you below 1 hit point. When the minute ends, you gain one level of exhaustion for each time this protection kept you standing.

Midi-QOL

A reaction offered when incoming damage is at least your current hit points plus temporary hit points (before resistances). The Second Breath effect lasts 1 minute and uses an isDamaged macro; exhaustion is applied when it ends.

activation.condition: When damage would reduce you to 0 hit points

effects.name: Second Breath
effects.description: Damage can't reduce you below 1 hit point. Gain a level of exhaustion for each time it does when this ends.

macro.name: Draught of the Second Breath
